props.gloss_en: R' Ami: a person should always complete his portions with the congregation -- twice Scripture and once Targum
even a verse of bare place-names such as 'Atarot and Divon' (Num 32:3) is read twice and its Targum once
whoever completes his portions with the congregation -- his days and years are lengthened
(entertained) Rav Bivi bar Abaye's plan: complete the whole year's portions on the eve of Yom Kippur

'you shall afflict your souls on the ninth of the month at evening' (Lev 23:32) -- yet one fasts on the tenth; rather the verse tells you: whoever eats and drinks on the ninth, Scripture credits him as though he fasted on the ninth and the tenth
(entertained) Rav Bivi's second plan: read the portions in advance of the congregation
provided that he neither advances nor delays [his reading relative to the congregation]
R' Yehoshua ben Levi to his sons: complete your portions with the congregation, twice Scripture and once Targum
and be careful with the veins [in slaughtering a bird], in accordance with R' Yehuda
R' Yehuda in the mishnah (Chullin 2:1): [a bird's slaughter is not valid] until he cuts the veins
and be careful [to honour] an elder who forgot his learning through duress
the ground: as we say, the tablets and the broken tablets lie [together] in the Ark
Rava to his sons: when you cut meat, do not cut it on the hand
some say: [the meat rule is] because of danger [of cutting the hand]
and some say: because it spoils the meal
Rava: and do not sit on the bed of an Aramean woman
Rava: and do not pass behind the synagogue while the congregation is praying
reading 1: 'the bed of an Aramean woman' means -- do not go to sleep without reciting the Shema
reading 2: it means -- do not marry a convert
reading 3: an Aramean woman literally
from the incident the Sages said: it is forbidden to sit on the bed of an Aramean woman (Rav Pappa would not sit until she lifted the bed, and a dead infant was found beneath it)
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: a person may not pass behind the synagogue while the congregation is praying
Abaye: we said this only where there is no other entrance [to the synagogue]
and only where there is no other synagogue [in the town]
and only where he is not carrying a load
and only where he is not running
and only where he is not wearing tefillin -- if any one of these holds, there is nothing to it

supports.gloss_en: כדאמר להו רבי יהושע בן לוי לבניה: אשלימו פרשיותייכו עם הצבור -- as RYbL told his sons: with the congregation, not before or after

ומשום מעשה דרב פפא -- Rav Pappa would not sit on the Aramean woman's bed until she lifted it, and a dead infant was found there; מכאן אמרו חכמים אסור לישב על מטת ארמית (an incident, not a svara: no support kind exists for a מעשה)
ואל תעברו אחורי בית הכנסת בשעה שהצבור מתפללין -- מסייע ליה לרבי יהושע בן לוי: Rava's instruction to his sons says what RYbL rules

objections.gloss_en: תנא ליה: כתיב ועניתם את נפשותיכם בתשעה לחודש בערב... כל האוכל ושותה בתשיעי מעלה עליו הכתוב כאילו מתענה תשיעי ועשירי -- eating and drinking on the ninth is itself credited as fasting; (Rashi / Steinsaltz: so the eve of Yom Kippur is given over to eating, not to catching up on the year's portions)

אמר ליה ההוא סבא, תנינא: ובלבד שלא יקדים ולא יאחר -- one reads with the congregation, neither in advance nor in arrears (marker תנינא; the clause is tannaitic but not in the Mishnah, hence kind tanya)
